About Us
Welcome to 
EVEREST METAL
 in Tiruchirappalli. Premium Quality Steels Supplier Trichy & Pan India. We established in 2007. Has been synonymous with excellence and commitment to customer satisfaction. We understand the importance Structural Steel Solutions of reliable materials in are tested by high premium quality experts to ensure 100 % Satisfactory results your every project. Timely delivery & Customer supply services shortly across the country with a product mix including long and flat steel products of all the top manufacturers in the country. Conform to both Indian and European Standards. Has Complete Understanding of Industrial & Projects Customer’s needs. Due to increase in the demand of different type of products core business in dealing steel sector.

Our Vision
To be the first and last place our customers need to look for all their steel needs. 
To be a globally admired organization that manufactures innovative steel 
 prodect throught sustainable industrial business development and delivering 
 excellence with reliability.
Our Mission
To achieve consistent growth through superior customer service, quality and commitment. We aim to be relentless in the pursuit of customer satisfaction and employee excellence 
 For our customers, we aim to be a compelling place to purchase from by consistently providing quality products at low prices, as conveniently as possible. For our associates and employees, we aim to be easy and enjoyable to work with by providing exceptional commitment to their target goals. 
Grade of Materials
 We are in a position to supply materials in various special grades and dimensions to best suit 
 the customer’s requirements. 
High Tensile Plate / Structural Steel Plate:
 Sailma E-350 / E-410 / E-450 / E-550 Plates, E-250BR A B C, E-350BR A B C, S355J2+N,
 Sailhard, Uttamhard, Jindalhard, Corten A/B, IRMS 41/97, ASTM A-36, C45,
 Carbon Steel EN8, EN19, EN24, EN31,
 Pressure Vessel Plates SA516 Gr.70, SA537 Cl.1 & Cl.2, Hardox 400/450/500 
 We sincerely appreciate the time and interest you have devoted to our products. 
 Should you have any queries, require additional information, or wish to schedule a meeting, 
 please do not hesitate to contact us. 
 Once again, we express our deepest gratitude for your support, and we eagerly anticipate 
 collaborating with you. 
JSPL Parallel Flange Beams UB & UC Columns
 Wide Range: Widest product range available in the country lending more Flexibility to designers and a more cost active option to project owners Exceptional Sectional Properties: Better sectional properties as compared to conventional tapered flange beams leading to e_cient design and lower steel usage. Availability of hi-tensile steel grades enables designers/ users to further cut on steel tonnage Steel Saving: Steel savings with parallel flange sections under bending load as well as under axial compression are appreciable when compared with tapered flange sections enabling usage of lower beam sizes Higher Load carrying capacity: Exhibits higher load-carrying capacity with Parallel Flange Beams • sections under direct compression (when used as columns) owing to their higher radius of gyration values about ‘y-y’ axis and reduced slenderness ratio of beams, thus increasing stress-bearing limits Faster Construction: Simpler direct bolting of connections to flanges possible, as taper washers are not required. Flange-to-Flange welding Possible as flanges are parallel Ease in design: Enables complex design and fabrication in high volumes because of the inherent functional advantages f Parallel Flange Beams.
